description: This Java source file defines the TitleEditor Activity for an Android Notepad app. It provides functionality for editing the title of a note, including loading the current title from the content provider, allowing user edits, and saving changes back to the provider.

classes.name: TitleEditor
classes.description: An Activity that allows editing the title of a note, displaying an EditText and handling loading and saving the note's title.

methods.name: onCreate
methods.description: Initializes the Activity, sets the content view, retrieves the note URI, loads the current note title into the EditText.

methods.name: onResume
methods.description: Currently does nothing but calls the superclass method; can be used for additional behavior when activity resumes.

methods.name: onPause
methods.description: Currently does nothing but calls the superclass method; can be used for pausing behavior.

methods.name: onStop
methods.description: Calls saveTitle() to persist any changes when the activity is stopped.

methods.name: onClickOk
methods.description: Handles the OK button click event, saves the title, and finishes the activity.

methods.name: saveTitle
methods.description: Checks if the edited title has changed, then updates the content provider with the new title, or shows a toast if the title is empty.
